envs.name: tabularht
envs.doc: The package provides the following environments that extend the tabular/array environment by a height specification as first argument: • tabularht, tabularht* • arrayht • tabularhtx (if package tabularx is loaded) The height argument allows a length specification, package calc is supported if used. This means, the tabular will have the specified height.
